dialogues.speaker: Stepanyan
dialogues.text: I must continue tempering my will until I become a reliable company commander...

dialogues.speaker: Stepanyan
dialogues.text: Hm? Oh, it's you... Glad to meet you again.

dialogues.speaker: Stepanyan
dialogues.text: Yes. Recently, my superiors put me in charge of all company affairs, and my duties became much more complicated overnight.

dialogues.speaker: Stepanyan
dialogues.text: Handling all the tedious, drawn-out paperwork and keeping a unit running smoothly is fundamentally different from fighting on the front lines.

dialogues.speaker: Stepanyan
dialogues.text: Combat skills have become secondary. What matters more now is overall awareness, and the ability to schedule and coordinate tasks.

dialogues.speaker: Stepanyan
dialogues.text: Ahh, I still prefer fighting on the front lines...

dialogues.speaker: Stepanyan
dialogues.text: However, to become a proper war machine, I must be capable in every respect.

dialogues.speaker: Stepanyan
dialogues.text: Thank you for the encouragement. I will do my best every day.

dialogues.speaker: Stepanyan
dialogues.text: Yes. I was once deployed near the Experimental Design Bureau in Nod-Krai, and I had the honor of exchanging a few blows with you. You defeated me without breaking a sweat, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Stepanyan
dialogues.text: Naturally, it's to be expected that you don't remember me.

dialogues.speaker: Stepanyan
dialogues.text: After all, at least a hundred Fatui soldiers who earned the Fireblade Shock Trooper qualification badge have fallen at your hands.

dialogues.speaker: Stepanyan
dialogues.text: You may simply think of me as an ordinary soldier, the kind you might find anywhere on the roadside.
